checks.definition:
checks for crm_client:

        SELECT k.client_id FROM crm_client k
        WHERE k.type_personne = 'souscripteur'
          AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM crm_contrat c WHERE c.souscripteur_id = k.client_id)
